notes: Names the vision endpoint's real error instead of retrying it for 3 minutes. The last log showed the endpoint answering HTTP 500 instantly, 42 times — a deterministic failure, not a cold start, and the app was discarding the response body that says why. Error responses are now read and logged in full ('HTTP 500 body: …'), the same status arriving three times in a row stops the retry loop immediately with a plain-language verdict pointing at the RunPod console, and the failure toast shows the endpoint's actual error instead of a generic message. Next failed photo-read, the troubleshooting log will contain the endpoint's own words for what's wrong.
